pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed jagged geometries resembling oak leaves or stars. Patches exhibit diffuse edge gradients and vary in spatial area, with larger, more complex shapes on the anterior flank and smaller, more defined shapes on the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, light-colored topological network with variable pixel width. Exhibits a high density of tri-point and tetra-point junction nodes. Pathways are most constricted at the points where the jagged patch vertices nearly touch.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour visible along the superior neck line, though detail is degraded by soft-focus blur against the desaturated background.
